message:
Ah, storms. They can really shake things up, can't they? I remember one particularly rainy evening when the thunder rumbled like an old man grumbling about his coffee being too cold. We made a cozy setup with blankets and snacks, turning the whole ordeal into a family movie night. 

If you ever find yourself in a stormy situation, it’s handy to know what to do ahead of time. There are great resources out there to help you prepare, so you can keep the cozy vibe going, no matter what the weather throws your way. 

What’s your favorite way to make a stormy day feel a little brighter? ☔
